disqualifier.note: Local TypeScript projection of the Firecrawl agent SDK request. strictConstrainToURLs is an optional SDK mode over an independently optional urls list, not a presence restatement of urls.
Firecrawl browser-session SDK wire. streamWebView is an independently reported session fact beside optional interactiveLiveViewUrl; liveViewUrl is required on both values of the flag.
Firecrawl queue-status SDK envelope. success is the call envelope; mostRecentSuccess is a nullable timestamp of the last successful job, not a payload whose presence is restated by success.
graphology constructor options at the sigma.js fallback boundary. multi is an independent multi-graph knob; type is pinned to directed and is not a second boolean axis.
Independent decode predicates over different config strings (API base URL vs OAuth redirect URI). Combined-true is not a state of one object.
